job.title: Middleweight Integrated Project Manager
job.description:
We’re looking for an experienced and proactive Integrated Project Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day delivery and success of our client work.
  
This is a 3 month FTC - Full time with 2 days in the office
  
A t the heart of the team, this is a highly client-facing role responsible for driving projects forward from initial brief through to final delivery. You’ll build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring projects are well planned, effectively managed and delivered to the highest standard.
Acting as the link between strategy, creative, production, media and client teams, you’ll bring structure, clarity and momentum to the account, making sure everyone is aligned and the work is delivered on time, within budget and to the agreed scope.
You'll be naturally organised and solutions-focused, with the confidence to take ownership, anticipate challenges and keep things moving. Equally, you'll thrive in a fast-paced creative environment where priorities can evolve and a pragmatic, hands-on approach is essential.
  
Key Responsibilities
  • Take ownership of the day-to-day delivery of client accounts, ensuring all projects are delivered to a high standard, on time and within agreed scope.
  • Build and maintain strong, trusted client relationships, confidently managing day-to-day communication, expectations and challenges.
  • Lead project planning and workflows from initial briefing through strategy, creative development, production and final delivery.
  • Manage multiple workstreams across integrated campaigns, social and content-led activity, ensuring teams remain aligned on priorities, timings and responsibilities.
  • Work collaboratively with strategy, creative, production, media and specialist partners to ensure a seamless and integrated approach to delivery.
  • Own project timelines, budgets, scopes and resource requirements, maintaining strong commercial oversight and financial control.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies and potential challenges, developing solutions before they impact delivery.
  • Lead effective project status meetings, maintaining clear documentation, tracking actions and ensuring accountability across the team.
  • Manage client feedback and internal amends processes, balancing client expectations with creative quality and delivery requirements.
  • Oversee quality control across all project outputs, ensuring work meets the required standards before delivery.
  • Support senior account and agency leadership with project reporting, forecasting, account health updates and key client meetings.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, workflows and ways of working, championing greater efficiency and collaboration across the account.
  
Experience & Skills
  • Proven experience as a Project Manager within a creative, advertising, social or integrated agency environment, with the ambition and capability to take the next step.
  • Strong client-facing experience, with the confidence and judgement to build trusted relationships and lead day-to-day client conversations.
  • Experience delivering integrated campaigns and social-first, content-led projects, ideally for FMCG, consumer or household brands.
  • A strong understanding of the end-to-end project lifecycle, including briefing, strategy, creative development, production and delivery.
  • Demonstrable experience managing budgets, scopes, timelines and resources across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain oversight of complex projects and competing priorities.
  • A proactive, solutions-led mindset, with the ability to anticipate challenges, take ownership and drive projects forward.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring clarity to complex situations while keeping multiple stakeholders aligned.
  • A balance of strong project management discipline and commercial awareness, alongside the flexibility and pragmatism needed in a creative environment.
  • A collaborative team player who enjoys bringing people together and enabling others to produce their best work.
  • Comfortable working at pace, adapting to changing priorities and maintaining perspective on the bigger picture.
  
What Success Looks Like
  • Client accounts run smoothly, with clear ownership, effective planning and minimal surprises.
  • Clients feel confident, informed and supported, viewing the agency team as a trusted and valued partner.
  • Internal teams have the clarity, information and time they need to deliver their best work.
  • Projects are commercially well managed and delivered on time, within budget and to the agreed scope.
  • Creative quality is protected throughout the delivery process.
  • Risks and challenges are identified early and addressed proactively.
  • Strong, collaborative and efficient ways of working are embedded and continually developed across the account.

job.title: Senior Social Copywriter
job.description:
My client is looking for a hands-on, highly conceptual Senior Creative who can bridge the worlds of advertising and social.

This is an opportunity for someone who can think beyond traditional social content and develop ideas that genuinely capture attention, spark conversation and become part of culture.

You'll be equally comfortable developing a big campaign platform, activation or experiential idea as you are creating culturally relevant, platform-native social work. We want someone with a strong advertising background with an instinctive understanding of social platforms and a portfolio that demonstrates creative thinking, originality and ambition.

Working closely with Creative Directors and the wider creative team, you'll take ideas from the initial concept through to execution, creating work that moves seamlessly between integrated campaigns, activations, content and culture.

This isn't simply a BAU social role. We're looking for someone who is passionate about producing standout, award-worthy creative, understands what makes people engage and participate, and knows how to translate cultural insights into powerful brand ideas.

Key Responsibilities

Conceptual & Social Creativity
  • Develop bold, original ideas across social, integrated campaigns, activations, experiential, digital and emerging platforms.
  • Bring the same conceptual ambition to a TikTok, Reel or reactive social opportunity as you would to a major advertising campaign.
  • Create ideas that go beyond posts and content calendars, generating attention, conversation and cultural relevance.
  • Translate cultural observations, audience behaviours, platform trends and brand insights into simple, powerful creative ideas.
  • Identify opportunities for brands to actively participate in and influence culture, rather than simply follow it.
  • Develop ideas that can originate in social and grow into bigger campaigns, as well as finding compelling social expressions of larger campaign platforms.
  • Work closely with Creative Directors to develop, challenge and elevate ideas from initial concept through to execution.
Creative Craft & Making
  • Take ideas from a blank page through to execution, including concepts, scripts, social formats, treatments, storyboards, copy, creator briefs and presentations.
  • Be hands-on in developing, making and prototyping ideas, bringing creative thinking to life.
  • Work collaboratively with designers, writers, editors, creators, producers and production partners to deliver high-quality work.
  • Understand how creative execution needs to adapt to different platforms, audiences and contexts without compromising the strength of the idea.
  • Explore new creative tools, technologies and production approaches to push the boundaries of what's possible.
  • Incorporate Generative AI and emerging technologies into the creative process, using them to explore, prototype and develop ideas.
Social & Cultural Understanding
  • Have an in-depth understanding of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit and emerging social platforms, including their audiences, communities, creators and formats.
  • Stay curious about internet culture, entertainment, technology, creators, memes, trends and emerging behaviours.
  • Understand what makes an idea genuinely social, rather than simply advertising placed on social platforms.
  • Bring a strong point of view on social creativity and help educate clients and internal teams on emerging behaviours and creative opportunities.
Leadership & Collaboration
  • Mentor and inspire junior creatives, designers and content creators, helping develop their conceptual thinking and creative craft.
  • Provide clear, constructive feedback that challenges and strengthens creative ideas.
  • Present and sell ideas confidently, articulating the thinking behind the work and bringing clients and collaborators on board.
  • Help foster an ambitious, collaborative and creatively curious environment, with a strong focus on the quality of the work.
About You
  • A strong conceptual advertising background, with the ability to develop big ideas and translate them into engaging social-first executions.
  • A portfolio demonstrating original thinking, integrated campaigns and culturally relevant social work.
  • Experience creating work with award-winning potential, with a genuine ambition to push creative boundaries.
  • Deep understanding of social platforms, creators, communities and online culture.
  • Equally comfortable developing campaign platforms, activations and experiential ideas as you are creating fast-moving social content.
  • A confident storyteller, with strong copywriting, scripting and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on and proactive, with the ability to concept, write, make and prototype ideas yourself.
  • Comfortable working with Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Kling and other emerging creative technologies.
  • Collaborative, curious and ambitious, with a passion for producing work that makes people stop, think, engage and share.
Above all, we're looking for a creative thinker who understands that great social work starts with a great idea – not simply a platform or a format.

job.title: Founder Copywriter - AI, Science Fiction & Social Storytelling
job.description:
The Opportunity

My client is looking for an exceptional Founding Writer to help create an entirely new, AI-native and social-native science-fiction universe.
  
The ambition is to create a distinctive science-fiction universe with its own visual identity, compelling characters and rich mythology, blending imaginative world-building with contemporary culture and the possibilities of digital storytelling.
  
This is an opportunity to help build something from the ground up, creating an original universe designed to live across social media, entertainment and emerging platforms.
  
We're looking for an imaginative storyteller who can move effortlessly between long-term mythology and short-form digital storytelling. Someone who understands how to build rich fictional worlds, develop compelling characters and create stories that capture attention, spark conversation and inspire participation.
  
You could come from advertising, film, entertainment, gaming, social or a combination of creative disciplines. What matters most is your imagination, writing ability, cultural awareness and appetite to experiment with new technology.
  
The Role & Responsibilities
  • Help define the creative vision, tone of voice and narrative direction for an original science-fiction universe.
  • Create unforgettable characters, extraordinary worlds, detailed mythologies and interconnected storylines.
  • Develop repeatable storytelling frameworks and narrative engines capable of generating a vast universe of stories and content.
  • Conceptualise and write social-first storytelling formats with the potential to become cultural phenomena.
  • Write exceptional short-form science-fiction stories, particularly 30–90-second scripts that are cinematic, emotionally engaging, imaginative and designed to capture attention.
  • Combine traditional storytelling craft with an understanding of social culture, internet behaviour, memes, creators, trends and platform algorithms.
  • Explore how stories can evolve through audience participation, community engagement and emerging digital formats.
  • Be hands-on in the creative process, writing, making, testing and experimenting rather than simply directing others.
  • Push the creative possibilities of AI, developing expertise in emerging models, prompting techniques, workflows and tools to transform how stories are imagined and produced.
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to bring ambitious creative ideas to life.
  
About You
  • An exceptional writer and storyteller with a strong imagination and the ability to create original worlds, characters and narratives.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: advertising, creative agencies, film, entertainment, gaming, social content or digital storytelling.
  • A strong understanding of internet culture and what makes content resonate, travel and capture people's attention.
  • Equally comfortable developing a complex fictional universe and writing a compelling 30-second social video.
  • A natural conceptual thinker who can bring unexpected ideas, originality and a distinctive creative perspective.
  • Passionate about science fiction, speculative worlds, emerging technology and the possibilities of storytelling.
  • Actively experimenting with AI tools and interested in how they can transform creative development and production.
  • Hands-on, entrepreneurial and comfortable working in an evolving environment where there is no established playbook.
  • Ambitious, curious and excited by the opportunity to help build something entirely new.
  
Why This Role?
This is a genuine founding opportunity. You won't be inheriting an existing creative framework or simply delivering against an established brief. You'll help shape the vision, build the mythology and establish the storytelling language for an entirely new science-fiction universe.
  
It's a chance to combine imagination, storytelling, technology and culture in a way that pushes the boundaries of what creative content can be.
  
Location: Candidates must be based in the UK or EU. Applications from candidates based outside these regions will not be considered. Working remotely with regular meetings in Europe.

Salary: £80,000 - £115,000 plus equity

job.description:

*Please note this client is looking for someone from an HR/ People, Talent background. (not delivery operations) * 
  
You will support in the operational success of the business, ensuring efficiency, profitability and competitiveness within the market.
  
You will ensure your team is set up for success, motivated and happy, giving them clear KPIs and goals to achieve.
This could be achieved through a combination of restructuring, automation, cost optimisation and systems implementation, while keeping people at the heart of every decision.
  • Practical hybrid working- London office (go in when it makes sense but this person will need to be visible)
  • Permanent role
  • £90k-£110k depending on experience + benefits  
The role:
  • Ensure best practice and ways of working across the business
  • Support heads of departments across all things HR, culture, team management and give them support and plans of action (this is not a hands on HR role)
  • Make sure all internal systems and operations platforms are embedded into the business for the teams to do their best work
  • Set the wider transformation agenda, work with leadership, oversee major programmes and be accountable for delivering strategic business benefits
  • Identify what needs to improve, and lead or coordinate the changes needed to get better results

12 month FTC 

Are you an experienced Senior Project Manager ready to take ownership of a prestigious account?

We’re looking for a proactive and commercially minded Senior Project Manager with a strong background in managing high-volume CRM communications, specifically email and direct mail (DM), from initial brief through to final delivery.

In this role, you’ll lead the end-to-end delivery of CRM communications, acting as the central point of contact across client services, strategy, creative, copy, design, production and deployment teams. You’ll oversee project workflows, manage budgets and timelines, and build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring all communications are delivered accurately, efficiently and on time.
What You’ll Do
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of CRM communications across email and direct mail, from briefing and planning through to production, approval and final delivery.
  • Manage multiple projects and high-volume creative briefs simultaneously, ensuring all deliverables meet agreed deadlines, budgets and quality standards.
  • Own project scope, timelines, budgets and resource planning, proactively identifying risks and resolving issues before they escalate.
  • Coordinate the development and delivery of CRM assets, working closely with copy, creative, design, production and relevant technical teams.

  • Work closely with client leadership and account teams to manage incoming briefs, forecast workload and balance priorities against team capacity.
  • Monitor project budgets, revenue reconciliation and project spend in collaboration with finance and account teams.
  • Ensure email and direct mail communications are delivered accurately, with strong attention to detail across content, data, personalisation, formats and final production requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, streamline processes and enhance the efficiency and quality of CRM delivery.
About You
  • Experienced: Currently operating at Senior Project Manager level, with experience managing complex, high-volume projects from briefing through to delivery. Experience in CRM, email and direct mail communications is essential.
  • Highly Organised: Comfortable managing multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • A Strong Relationship Builder: Confident working with clients and cross-functional teams, building trusted relationships and communicating effectively at all levels.
  • Commercially Minded: Experienced in managing budgets, project costs, resource allocation and financial reporting.
  • A Proactive Problem Solver: Able to anticipate challenges, manage changing priorities and find practical solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Process Driven: Experienced in project management methodologies, systems and workflows, with a focus on accuracy, efficiency and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborative: Skilled at coordinating creative, copy, design, production and technical teams to deliver high-quality CRM communications.

job.title: Senior Financial Controller- Fashion Retail Brand
job.description:
The Senior Financial Controller acts as the CFO’s number 2, overseeing the day-to-day management and operation of the Finance function.

The role is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, maintaining robust financial controls, and managing the core processes that support the smooth running of the business.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-growing, dynamic environment where systems and processes are continually evolving. The successful candidate will be adaptable, commercially minded and comfortable responding to changing priorities, while establishing clear processes, strengthening financial controls and supporting the business’s continued growth.

This is an initial contract role, with the view to extend and ideally become permanent.

Please still apply if you are only interested in contract work.
  • Immediate start
  • Monthly rolling contract- could be long term contract or convert to a permanent role if it suits long term
  • 3 days in the London office
  • Circa £85k + 
The role:
  • Oversee the day-to-day Finance function, serving as the primary point of contact and escalation for finance-related matters.
  • Lead, support and develop the Finance team, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, deadlines and expectations for accuracy, quality and accountability.
  • Communicate effectively across departments, fostering strong working relationships and addressing issues promptly, collaboratively and pragmatically.
  • Take ownership of routine operational finance matters, ensuring they are resolved efficiently within the team and enabling the CFO to focus on strategic priorities, funding, Board and investor relations, and key commercial decisions.
  • Lead the monthly and quarterly financial close and reporting cycle, including P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reporting, across multiple entities
  • Ensure the integrity and consistency of historical and comparative financial data, maintaining robust supporting schedules, documentation and clear audit trails.
  • Deliver insightful variance analysis against budget, forecast and prior periods, identifying emerging cost trends, significant movements, financial risks and recommended corrective actions.
  • Oversee balance sheet reconciliations and key accounting entries, including accruals, prepayments, payroll, depreciation, revenue, stock and cost of goods sold (COGS).
  • Establish and embed effective financial controls, policies and processes that meet the needs of the current business while supporting future growth and scalability.
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, ensuring effective management of aged creditors, debtor collections, supplier payment schedules
  • Manage bank reconciliations and day-to-day banking operations
  • Cash flow forecasting-, provide visibility of liquidity requirements, upcoming financial commitments and any risks or actions requiring attention
  • Implement and maintain robust controls over expenses, vendor onboarding, supplier records and payment processes.
  • Review and approve payroll
  • Lead the Finance workstream for banking and payment infrastructure initiatives, including bank migrations, process improvements and changes to payment approval workflows.
  • Oversee working capital reporting across payables, receivables, inventory and other significant cash commitments, providing clear insight into financial risks, priorities and required actions.
  • Maintain robust financial controls over stock, including valuation, reconciliations, provisions and adjustments, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of inventory balances across all channels and locations.
  • Ensure the accurate and consistent accounting of cost of goods sold (COGS), landed costs, freight, duties and other inventory-related expenses.
  • Gross margin reporting, working closely with Merchandising, Production and Operations to investigate discrepancies and proactively identify margin erosion and inventory risks.
  • Ensure accuracy and reliability of financial data flowing between Retail 24/7, Shopify, Xero etc
  • Lead the year-end financial reporting process and annual audit
  • Oversee day-to-day Finance compliance, including VAT, PAYE/NIC, PSA/P11D and corporation tax reporting, liaising with external tax advisers etc
  • Manage and support multi-entity and international tax, VAT, customs and duty compliance as the business grows and expands into new markets.
  • Maintain a robust, well-organised and audit-ready Finance function, ensuring financial records and supporting documentation are readily available for investor, lender and other due diligence requirements.
  • Partner with department heads to strengthen financial accountability, scrutinise expenditure and ensure the financial impact of key decisions
  • Coordinate the annual budgeting and reforecasting processes, consolidating departmental inputs and constructively challenging assumptions to ensure realistic and robust financial plans.
  • Provide clear, actionable financial analysis across costs, margins, cash flow and profitability to inform operational priorities, commercial decisions and investment opportunities.
  • Financial forecasting, scenario planning and modelling
  • Automate processes and improve the use of financial data to drive efficiency
The Person:

·       Fully Qualified (ACA/ ACCA/ CIMA) with strong Financial controller, Senior           Finance manager or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrable experience managing the month-end close, monthly and quarterly financial reporting, balance sheet integrity, accounts payable and receivable, and year-end audit preparation.
  • Experience within an omnichannel consumer-facing business, ideally in the fashion industry, with a strong understanding of inventory management, working capital optimisation and gross margin performance.
  • Strong Excel skills, ideally Xero, Shopify and Retail 24/7

job.title: Account Manager - ATL
job.description:
Are you an Account Manager who loves brilliant ideas and knows how to help make them happen?

This role is for a very successful and well known London creative agency to work on a flagship account - a bold and brave FMCG brand producing some brilliant work at a brand level.

You will join a friendly but super ambitious and driven agency team delivering work spanning brand campaigns, content, social, partnerships, activations and more unexpected ideas!

This would suit an established AM, or a strong SAE ready for more ownership, who enjoys being close to the creative and production process. You don’t need to know everything already, but you should be curious, organised and excited by the opportunity to develop your strategic and creative instincts.

What you’ll be doing:
  • Running your own projects and workstreams from initial brief through to final delivery.
  • Building a strong day-to-day relationship with clients and becoming someone they can rely on.
  • Working closely with creative, strategy, production and project management teams to turn ideas into great work.
  • Keeping projects moving by managing timings, actions, feedback and deliverables.
  • Getting involved in briefs and contributing your perspective on audiences, culture and the wider category.
  • Supporting integrated campaigns across traditional and digital channels, including social, content, partnerships and live activity.
  • Managing production across selected projects, working with producers, creators, suppliers and other external partners.
  • Coordinating work across different markets and helping local teams adapt campaigns where needed.
  • Protecting the original idea and standard of craft as work develops across different formats and channels.
  • Managing estimates, budgets and project scope with support from senior members of the team.
  • Anticipating problems, finding practical solutions and knowing when to ask for help.
  • Supporting more junior team members and helping create a positive, collaborative working environment.
What they’re looking for
  • Experience in an agency account management or integrated project delivery role.
  • A good understanding of how creative work is developed, produced and delivered.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for creativity and a desire to make the work as good as it can be.
  • Curiosity about clients, audiences, culture and why particular ideas will connect.
  • Experience across a mix of channels rather than one narrow specialism.
  • Confidence managing several projects, deadlines and stakeholders at once.
  • Clear, thoughtful communication and the ability to build trusted relationships.
  • A proactive approach: you take ownership, think ahead and follow things through.
  • Calmness when priorities change or a project takes an unexpected turn.
  • An understanding of budgets, scope and the commercial realities of agency life.
  • International or multi-market experience would be useful, but isn’t essential.
  • Most importantly, positive energy, good judgement and plenty of appetite to learn.
It’s a great opportunity to work on creatively ambitious projects, learn from an experienced team and build towards the next stage of your career.
